issues.desc: CHK-001 and CHK-002 enumerate internal registry, selector, artifact, and signer mechanics but do not state their item-level user-observable completion signals. During PLAN, make the verificationIntent explicitly show that canonical views resolve deterministically, invalid/ambiguous selectors and evidence paths fail closed, and trusted signer/key lifecycle behavior is independently observable; CHK-003/004 already provide the aggregate red-to-green and integration outcome, so this is advisory rather than an INIT blocker.
